business_summary: Sunway Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of cable products in China. The company offers hydrogen peroxide, electronic-grade anhydrous hydrogen fluoride, electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid, and sulfuric acid. It also provides cables for nuclear facilities, rail transit, smart grid, flexible fireproof, solar photovoltaic power generation, and construction industries. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Star Cable Co., Ltd. Sunway Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Leshan, China.
